output.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin
FROM marts.fct_order_lines l
JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) DESC
LIMIT 3;
output.explanation: Gross margin per product = line net amount minus line COGS. Only lines of completed orders (is_revenue = true) placed in 2025 are counted. The query returns the top three products by margin, rounded to 2 decimals.
